summary.name: Endel
summary.one_liner: Endel is a personalized soundscape app that generates adaptive sound for focus, relaxation, sleep, and movement.
use_cases: Concentrating during work or study sessions
Falling asleep at night with soft sounds
Relaxing and reducing stress during the day
Staying grounded on walks or while moving
Playing background sound on a smart speaker or TV
summary.what_it_does: Endel generates soundscapes in real time that adapt to inputs such as time of day, weather, heart rate, location, and walking cadence. Modes include Focus, Relax, Sleep, and Activity, and an Autoplay option picks a soundscape based on the current state. Scenarios are timed, pre-generated sound sessions for specific tasks. The page says the app is available on iOS, Android, Apple Watch, Amazon Alexa, Apple TV, Fire TV, Mac, and a web player, and that some streaming albums are non-adaptive. The page also notes a paid subscription model.
notable: Soundscapes adapt in real time to weather, time of day, heart rate and location
Standalone Apple Watch app that works without the iPhone
Works with Alexa voice commands and Alexa Routines
Sound tuned to 440 Hz and includes a Binaural Beats scenario
caveats: Subscription model: the page says a paid subscription supports ongoing development
Binaural Beats scenario requires stereo headphones
Streaming-platform albums are not personalized or adaptive
Effectiveness is subjective; the page admits it may not work for everyone
